output.population: Older persons, including those with malnutrition or risk of malnutrition, specific diseases, dehydration risk, and obese older persons with weight-related health problems.
output.intervention: Individualized nutrition and hydration care including screening, nursing support, education, counseling, food modification, oral supplements, and enteral/parenteral nutrition when indicated.
output.intervention_or_exposure: Clinical nutrition and hydration interventions for older persons.
output.outcome: Prevention/treatment of malnutrition and dehydration and support of nutritional status, clinical course, and quality of life.
output.recommendation: Routinely screen all older persons for malnutrition; support oral nutrition as needed; use enteral nutrition when oral intake is insufficient or impossible and parenteral nutrition when enteral intake is insufficient or impossible if prognosis is favorable; generally avoid dietary restrictions; consider weight-reducing diets only in obese older persons with weight-related health problems and combine with physical exercise; encourage adequate fluid intake; individualize care within a multimodal multidisciplinary approach.
output.applicability_boundary: Applies to older persons under the ESPEN geriatric nutrition and hydration guideline; weight-reduction advice is specifically limited to obese older persons with weight-related health problems and combined exercise.
output.source_span: all older persons shall routinely be screened for malnutrition in order to identify an existing risk early
